units.title: Manage Identity and Access
units.summary: Identity is the control plane of the Azure cloud. This unit covers Microsoft Entra ID tenants, users and groups; authentication with MFA, passwordless and Conditional Access; authorization through Azure RBAC, Entra roles and Privileged Identity Management; and the workload identities (managed identities and service principals) that let applications authenticate without stored secrets.

lessons.title: Microsoft Entra ID: Tenants, Users & Groups
Azure RBAC, Entra Roles & Privileged Identity Management

units.title: Secure Networking
units.summary: Defense in depth for Azure virtual networks. This unit covers filtering east-west and north-south traffic with network security groups, application security groups and Azure Firewall; keeping PaaS traffic off the public internet with Private Link, private endpoints and service endpoints, plus secure VM administration through Azure Bastion; and protecting internet-facing applications with the Web Application Firewall and Azure DDoS Protection.

lessons.title: Network Security Groups, ASGs & Azure Firewall
Private Link, Private Endpoints, Service Endpoints & Bastion
Edge Protection: Web Application Firewall & DDoS Protection

units.title: Secure Compute, Storage, and Databases
units.summary: Protecting the data-bearing resources of a subscription. This unit covers hardening virtual machines and encrypting disks; securing Azure Storage with encryption, SAS tokens and the storage firewall; defending Azure SQL with authentication, auditing, Transparent Data Encryption and data classification; and centralizing secrets, keys and certificates in Azure Key Vault.

units.title: Manage Security Operations
units.summary: Detecting, investigating and governing at scale. This unit covers Microsoft Defender for Cloud secure score, Defender workload-protection plans and just-in-time VM access; Microsoft Sentinel for SIEM analytics, incidents and SOAR automation; Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and the Kusto Query Language that powers both; and governance with Azure Policy to keep the estate compliant.

lessons.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud & JIT VM Access
